assertions.title: Helium keychain entry name is correct and documented

steps.action: Read src/browsers.ts and examine Helium browser definition's keychainEntries
steps.expected: keychainEntries contains primary entry following 'X Safe Storage' / 'X' convention with fallback
steps.observed: keychainEntries contains [{service: 'Helium Safe Storage', account: 'Helium'}, {service: 'Helium Storage Key', account: 'Helium'}]

steps.action: Verify primary entry follows Chromium 'X Safe Storage' / 'X' convention
steps.observed: Primary entry is {service: 'Helium Safe Storage', account: 'Helium'}, matching the Chromium convention used by Chrome ('Chrome Safe Storage'/'Chrome'), Brave ('Brave Safe Storage'/'Brave'), and Chromium ('Chromium Safe Storage'/'Chromium')

steps.action: Verify fallback entry exists for resilience
steps.expected: At least one fallback entry with legacy name
steps.observed: Fallback entry {service: 'Helium Storage Key', account: 'Helium'} present as second entry

steps.action: Check code comments for documentation of research and verification process
steps.expected: Detailed comments explaining why the entry name was changed from 'Helium Storage Key' to 'Helium Safe Storage'
steps.observed: Extensive multi-line comment block documents: (1) Helium is an ungoogled-chromium fork, (2) Chromium browsers use 'X Safe Storage' convention, (3) Previous 'Storage Key' pattern was incorrect, (4) Links to helium and helium-macos repos, (5) Research date 2026-04-10, (6) Explanation of primary vs fallback entries

steps.action: Verify keychain entries consumed correctly by getMacOSKey() in chrome-cookies.ts
steps.expected: getMacOSKey() iterates over keychainEntries candidates in order
steps.observed: getMacOSKey() calls getKeychainEntries(browser) and iterates candidates with for...of, trying each until one succeeds, matching the fallback pattern

steps.action: Verify tests exist for Helium keychain entries
steps.expected: Tests assert keychainEntries properties and convention
steps.observed: tests/browsers.test.ts includes: 'getBrowser: helium keychain entries follow chromium convention' test asserting entries.length >= 2, services include 'Helium', and all accounts are 'Helium'

codeRefs: src/browsers.ts lines ~63-88 (Helium browser definition with keychainEntries and comments)
src/browsers.ts lines ~112-127 (getMacOSKey using getKeychainEntries for fallback)

summary: Tested 1 assertion: VAL-HELIUM-001 PASSED. The Helium keychain entry name is correct and documented. Primary entry follows Chromium convention ('Helium Safe Storage' / 'Helium'), fallback entry preserves legacy name ('Helium Storage Key' / 'Helium') for resilience. Code comments thoroughly document the research and verification process, including the rationale for changing from 'Storage Key' to 'Safe Storage'.
